snippet.title: T.W.I.R.L. - Official Release Window Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Release Window Trailer for T.W.I.R.L., a first-person psychological horror game developed by Genie Boy Games. Players will embody a nine-year-old in their childhood home with a dark secret. Experience themes of identity, self-worth, and more on this stylistic yet horrific adventure. T.W.I.R.L. is launching in Summer 2026 for PC (Steam and itch.io), with Early Access available now through itch.io.

Wishlist the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458840/TWIRL/

#IGN #Gaming
